mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REQUEST AS RQ JOIN USER AS U ON RQ.uidx = U.uidx JOIN BOOKS AS B ON RQ.bidx = B.bidx WHERE RQ.delyn = 'N'

SELECT B.coverImg, B.title, B.originalTitle, B.subTitle, B.author, B.publisher, B.publishedYear, B.isbn, B.totalPages, B.sizeWidth, B.sizeHeight, B.weight, B.category, B.introduction, B.price, U.name, U.userNumber, RQ.rqidx, RQ.status, DATE_FORMAT(RQ.regDate, '%Y.%m.%d') AS regDate, RQ.rejectionReason FROM request RQ JOIN books B ON RQ.bidx = B.bidx JOIN `user` U ON RQ.uidx = U.uidx WHERE RQ.rqidx = #{rqidx} AND U.delyn = "N" AND B.delyn = "N" AND RQ.delyn = "N"

SELECT B.coverImg, B.title, B.author, B.publisher, U.name, U.userNumber, RQ.rqidx, RQ.regDate, RQ.status, RQ.rejectionReason
FROM REQUEST AS RQ JOIN USER AS U ON RQ.uidx = U.uidx
JOIN BOOKS AS B ON RQ.bidx = B.bidx WHERE RQ.delyn = 'N'
ORDER BY RQ.rqidx LIMIT #{startPageNum}, #{perPageNum};
SELECT B.* FROM REQUEST AS RQ JOIN BOOKS AS B ON B.bidx = RQ.bidx WHERE RQ.delyn = 'N' and RQ.rqidx = #{rqidx}
mapper.update: UPDATE REQUEST SET status = #{status}, modify = now() WHERE rqidx = #{rqidx}
